preprocessing.input: ADC-like single-phase current values; no defensible ampere calibration applied
preprocessing.fft: real FFT, N=650, 1 Hz bin spacing, 0-325 Hz
preprocessing.power: unnormalized squared FFT magnitude; comparable because all primary windows have equal length
preprocessing.model_scaling: training-set standardization only for scale-sensitive models

combined: time_domain + frequency_domain in the listed order

excluded.mean_centered: Deterministically zero after window centering; observed values are only floating-point residue (about +/-5.67e-14).

prohibited_unless_new_metadata_are_recov: features converted to amperes without a verified calibration equation
